greetingsDescription: Manage the join, leave and role messages of the server.
testDescription: Send a join or a leave message as if you had joined or left.
roleSetDescription: Set the messages sent when a member gets or loses a role.
roleRemoveDescription: Remove the messages of a role.
roleListDescription: List the role messages of the server.
optionsChannelDescription: The channel the messages are sent in.
optionsAddedDescription: Sent when a member gets the role. %user% mentions them, %role% is the role.
optionsRemovedDescription: Sent when a member loses the role. %user% mentions them, %role% is the role.
testNoMessages: The server has no message of this type. Add some in the greetings of `/settings server menu`.
testNoChannel: The server has no channel for this message. Set it in the greetings of `/settings server menu`.
testSentDirect: The message was sent to you in a direct message.
testFailed: I could not send the message: check that I can post in its channel, or that you take direct messages.
roleNoMessages: Write a message for when the role is given, taken, or both.
roleLimit: The server already has {{maximum}} role messages, the most it can have.
roleListEmpty: The server has no role messages. Add some with `/greetings role-set`.
